paragraphs: I am writing about the Senior Backend Engineer role at Northwind Labs. For the last six years I have worked on payment and ledger services, and your posting describes a settlement platform that its own team designs, runs and improves, which is the work I know best.

At my current company I own the ledger service that settles 40 million transactions a day. When it still settled in a nightly batch, a failed run meant a morning of reconciliation for three teams, so I led its move to an event-driven pipeline. Settlement lag went from hours to minutes, and the morning clean-up stopped.

I own a service end to end: design, delivery, on-call and the roadmap for it. I mentor two engineers, and most of what I teach them is how to make a change safe to ship on a system other teams depend on, which your posting names as the heart of the role.

The ledger work is where I do my best engineering, and I am looking for a team where payments are the product rather than a side system. I would welcome a conversation about how your team runs settlement today and where you want it to go.
